verdict.rationale: GoDaddy's docs show that API access uses Personal Access Tokens tied to specific capability scopes, required for v3 Domains APIs. Per-operation scopes such as `commerce.order:*` and `commerce.channel:read` are documented, and tokens can be created and revoked. That covers the scoped-credentials part of the story, but the pack has no evidence on account 2FA or on IP allowlisting for API access. Missing for 10: account-level 2FA (real/phishing-resistant), IP allowlisting on API/PAT access, independent or hands-on corroboration of scope enforcement.
